footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Franklin Templeton: after $428M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $59.3M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Sep 30, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 7.3% to $9.4B in fiscal 2026 (ended Sep 30, 2026). Operating income rose 94.7% to $1.2B, a 12.5% margin.
Net income rose 2.2× to $1.0B, or $1.97 per share. Operating cash flow was $837M and free cash flow $816M, versus $912M; Franklin Templeton returned $1.2B through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Franklin Templeton Inc. Form 10-K for FY2026 (SEC EDGAR)
